assumptionsAndLimits: The fictional vector-plus-A scan is one observation. Antibody-plus-B is a different product with its own time course. The unscaled curve is illustrative, and its area is not absorbed dose by itself: emissions and an appropriate tissue-dose model are also needed. This sketch uses no real isotope, patient result or efficacy value.
